title: Molten Nutella Lava Cookie Skillet
hookLine: 1-bowl brown-butter cookie dough hiding a frozen molten Nutella core in 15 mins.

steps.title: Preheat Air Fryer & Measure Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your air fryer to 330°F (165°C) for 3 minutes and line the basket with perforated parchment or a light oil mist. Measure out {nutella} and {butter_n} in a mixing bowl so they combine evenly.

steps.title: Whisk Dough & Stuff Nutella Core
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir {butter_n} with 1/3 cup brown sugar and 1 egg yolk, then fold in {flour_n}. Press half into a mini skillet, spoon {nutella} into the center, and seal with remaining dough.
steps.creatorSecret: Leave a little space around each piece in the air-fryer basket so hot air circulates evenly and creates crisp golden edges on Molten Nutella Lava Cookie Skillet.

steps.title: Bake Until Gooey & Scoop Ice Cream
steps.instructionTemplate: Top with {chips_n}. Bake or air-fry at 350°F (175°C) for 10 minutes until edges are golden crisp while center stays molten. Top immediately with vanilla bean ice cream!
steps.criticalTip: Pull it out 2 minutes earlier than you think—the hot cast iron keeps baking the base while you grab spoons.

steps.title: Rest 5 Minutes & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Carefully lift Molten Nutella Lava Cookie Skillet out of the air-fryer basket and rest 5 minutes on a cooling rack so the crust crisps up. Plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.

ugcQuotes.quote: Literally 15 mins from craving to spooning hot Nutella + cold vanilla ice cream.
